overviewHtml:
Two engineers investigating the same problem rarely take the same path. This prompt fixes the method, always starting from the problem, so results are reproducible and queries stay scoped.

What you get

  • Active problems listed in a table, or a pre-filled problem recognized
  • Log queries scoped to the problem timeframe
  • Classification of actionable errors
  • A handoff to trace investigation
getStartedHtml:
You need a Dynatrace environment, the Dynatrace for AI skills and a tool that reaches it (dtctl or the Dynatrace MCP server).

  1. Copy the prompt into your AI chat or prompt folder
  2. Describe the problem, or pick one from the list
  3. Follow the investigation through logs and traces
